summary: New lib recipe, field-lane: the inline padding that puts a field's label, helper and error on the control's TEXT LANE, where the typed text starts. That lane is the control's hairline plus its inline padding, written on --ui-stroke-hairline and the --ui-field-*-inset density tokens, so it moves with data-ui-density and a brand's stroke. fieldLane(size, kind) covers the soft inset, the full capsule and Input's brand-themed shape. It settles Combobox's open question on one inset rule for the field family.
